I will continue to investigate the root cause of the job failures and keep an eye on the system to ensure no further issues occur. Once I have a clear understanding of what caused the initial failure and any potential ongoing issues, I will provide a more comprehensive report and recommended next steps.

For now, here is a summary of my findings so far:
- The retry queue was blocked by 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table.
- These rows have been deleted, and the queue has been unblocked.

I will use the available tools to further investigate the job failures and will call submit_report when I have a complete understanding of the issue and can provide a recommended next step.
